recentItems.title: Israel Elections 2026: How Voting Procedure, Knesset Seats And Coalition Governments Work | WATCH
recentItems.description:
Israel Election 2026: How does Israel’s electoral system work, and who decides the next government? Voters elect party lists to the 120-seat Knesset through proportional representation, rather than choosing the prime minister directly. With a 3.25% electoral threshold and a fragmented multiparty system, coalition negotiations are crucial. Smaller parties can hold the balance of power, while surplus-vote agreements may influence seat distribution and shape Israel’s political future.

recentItems.title: EU Russian Frozen Assets Row Returns As Kaja Kallas Pushes For New Measures Ahead Of Halloween
recentItems.description:
EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas said on Monday that frozen Russian assets were back on the table as the bloc looked for ways to cover Ukraine's financing gap for 2027, warning that continued support is crucial to Kyiv's survival in the conflict.

Speaking after the Foreign Affairs Council meeting in Luxembourg, Kallas said ministers had discussed using Russia's frozen assets to help meet Ukraine's financial needs, with questions remaining over how EU member states would share the risks.

"Many [ministers] mentioned Russian frozen assets in this context. One important element is to reduce the security risks inside our borders, and that's why we were discussing also the issues regarding hybrid attacks, restricting the movement of Russian diplomats, reducing the number of Russian tourist visas, and working on a swift implementation of the entry ban for former Russian ex-combatants is crucial," she said.

recentItems.description:

Amid growing concerns over Russian hybrid warfare, sabotage and drone incursions across Europe, NATO is strengthening its defences while insisting that war with Russia is neither imminent nor inevitable.
